findings.title: Adding journal entries multiplies a plant's harvest count and harvested weight
findings.expected: harvest_count equals the number of harvests (3) whatever the number of journal entries
findings.actual: harvest_count is 12 (3 harvests x 4 journal entries). The new LEFT JOIN on journal_entries in PLANT_SELECT repeats each harvest row once per entry, so COUNT(h.id) is inflated. The detail page shows '2 harvests, 2.4 kg total' with only one harvest row listed

findings.title: Harvested weight inflated by the number of journal entries
findings.expected: harvest_grams equals the sum of the plant's harvests (1350 g)
findings.actual: harvest_grams is 5400 (shown as 5.4 kg on /plants), because SUM(h.weight_grams) runs over rows multiplied by the journal join
